LanguageData.LP_ArcanePower.label: arcane power
LanguageData.LP_ArcanePower.description: Power multiplier for wizard spells and the sorcerer's Intellectual branch: 0.5 + Intellectual level / 20, plus adventurer Intelligence modifier × 0.10 (× talent) and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02, +5% for each level the combined wizard / sorcerer class levels exceed 1 (up to +95%, i.e. level 20).
LanguageData.LP_PrimalPower.label: primal power
LanguageData.LP_PrimalPower.description: Power multiplier of the druid's Animals branch: 0.5 + Animals level / 20, plus adventurer Wisdom modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02, +2% for each level the combined druid class levels exceed 1 (up to +40%).
LanguageData.LP_VerdantPower.label: verdant power
LanguageData.LP_VerdantPower.description: Power multiplier of the druid's Plants branch: 0.5 + Plants level / 20, plus adventurer Wisdom modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02, +2% for each level the combined druid class levels exceed 1 (up to +40%).
LanguageData.LP_InnatePower.label: innate power
LanguageData.LP_InnatePower.description: Power multiplier of the sorcerer's Social branch: 0.5 + Social level / 20, plus adventurer Charisma modifier × 0.10 (× talent) and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02, +5% for each level the combined Social-based class levels such as sorcerer exceed 1 (up to +95%, i.e. level 20); +15% more with a sorcerer bloodline.
LanguageData.LP_ArtificePower.label: artifice power
LanguageData.LP_ArtificePower.description: Artificer ability power multiplier: 0.5 + Crafting level / 20, plus adventurer Intelligence modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02 (doesn't get the 10% of arcane power), +2% for each level the combined artificer class levels exceed 1 (up to +40%). Overcharged Shot's damage bonus and Rune Turret's damage are multiplied by it.
